summary: Shanghai YD Technology (Group) Co., LTD. specializes in the development and maintenance of process equipment and power support systems for semiconductor manufacturing plants. They offer integrated solutions that include planning, design, implementation, and maintenance, serving major semiconductor clients like Grace Semiconductor, ASE Group, and TSMC (China).
